prompt: Everything is realistic and photographic except the light itself, which is painted: every lamp, flame and glow is laid on in thick smeared strokes of pure colour, cadmium orange, rose and turquoise, bleeding into the air like wet paint, dreamlike. Faces stay realistic. Camera low on the back stairs, looking up past a dark wooden banister post in the foreground left. A heavy-set gangster in a chalk-stripe three-piece suit and grey fedora, with a broad pockmarked face, a flattened boxer's nose and a toothpick, leans close to a plain steel door at the bottom of narrow brick back stairs and murmurs into its open slot, where only two wary eyes look out. He stands right of centre, his face large in frame. 1920s: bare brick, a fire bucket, a crate of empty milk bottles, a wet stone floor. Most of the frame is in deep shadow; the painted lights are the brightest things in it. Plain margins with no writing. Thanks.
